credentials.name: n8n API
credentials.help: An API key for the instance you want to watch (Settings > n8n API). The template only reads workflows and executions.

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.help: Your Slack app's Bot User OAuth Token (OAuth & Permissions, starts with xoxb-). Scope chat:write.

credentials.name: SMTP
credentials.help: Optional: the email fallback when a Slack post fails. Skip it if you leave alert_email unset.

credentials.name: Supabase (Postgres)
nodes: Get the last 24 hours of failures
credentials.help: Your Supabase database connection string (Connect > Session pooler), for workflow-supabase.json only
